summary_md: **Nacer Noubir ([@nanoubir](https://x.com/nanoubir/status/2116611671175115014))** released **stele 1.0**, a Go tool that turns CLAUDE.md rules into enforced checks: it shows the rule before each write, verifies after it and again in CI, after seeing Claude Code break a rule in 3 of 8 eval runs ([lictor-ai/stele](https://github.com/lictor-ai/stele), [site](https://stele.lictorlabs.com)).
